title: Before harvest starts, I’ve had a lot of fun traveling to meet other ...
description: Before harvest starts, I’ve had a lot of fun traveling to meet other apple & pear growers! This time I was in Michigan, @Emily Kropf and her family hosted me and I had the best time 🤩 Michigan is a bit different than Washington when it comes to growing conditions. For instance, they get a lot more moisture, and overall moody weather being so close to the Great Lakes. ⛈️ Because of this, they have more of a hail threat for a wider window than us in WA. Kim & Chris Kropf decided to invest in a hail cannon do to the persistence of hail out there and the absolute carnage hail can have on a crop. Ok so what does a hail cannon do? From my understanding, they send big sound waves into the atmosphere which attempt to disrupt the formation of hailstones. These, depending on the size & stage the fruit is in, can dimple or CUT the fruit.☹️ The multi-generational orchardists say they’ve had good success with the tool!  Special thanks to Greenstone for getting me out to Michigan and setting up meetings with several of their AWESOME growers!! Stay tuned for more 🍎 content! #Michigan #Farmer #FarmEquipment #Science #Apples #LearnOnReels #AppleFarm #Orchard #Agriculture #Hail #Weather #AppleGirl
